primaryChecks.text: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
primaryChecks.previousContext: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
primaryChecks.nextContext: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 町名が列挙に明記される。

primaryChecks.text: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;
primaryChecks.previousContext: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
primaryChecks.nextContext: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 放牧地を伴う町名として明記される。4章32節のシメオン町一覧との連続性に整合する。
